segments.name: Indoor golf simulators
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells indoor golf simulators, launch monitors and related software for residential and commercial customers.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, the Company operates as one business segment, which is also the sole reportable segment, focusing on the manufacturing and sales of indoor golf simulators.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for golf simulators, content software subscriptions, and franchise fees and royalties from franchise operations.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company primarily recognizes revenue from: (i) golf simulators, (ii) content software subscriptions, and (iii) franchise operations, including regional developer territory fees, initial franchise fees, and ongoing royalty fees.
